intro: Kummarinchu Nee Atma is the latest Christian song from the album, Athi Parishuddha Stalamu written, composed & sung by gospel singer, Pastor Ravinder Vottepu and music composed by Jackie Vardhan. This song was released August 07, 2021 through Ravinder Vottepu YouTube channel.
